About.title: About the project
About.project: A Swagger/OpenAPI editor and viewer with a built-in REST client. Paste an OpenAPI specification in JSON or YAML, explore the endpoints and execute requests straight from the browser — requests are proxied through the server, so CORS is never an issue.

course.title: RS School
course.description: This application is the final project of the React course at RS School — a free, community-driven education program run by The Rolling Scopes. The course covers React, TypeScript, state management, testing and modern full-stack frameworks.
